// Build the LLM prompt here rather than inside an n8n expression:
// n8n's {{ }} parser closes on the first '}}' it sees, so any nested
// object literal inside an expression truncates it (learned the hard way
// — see docs/lessons.md #12).
const j = $('Normalize alert').item.json;
const prompt = [
  'You are a network automation dispatcher. Choose exactly ONE remediation',
  'template for the fault below. Reply with ONLY a JSON object, no prose:',
  '{"state": "<template name>", "reason": "<one short sentence>"}',
  '',
  'Allowed template names (choose one, never invent).',
  'Each one is described by the FAULT it repairs, not by the technology it',
  'touches. Matching on a shared word is how a real runbook gets applied to',
  'the wrong fault:',
  '- restore_interface : fault is that an interface was administratively shut.',
  '                      Re-enables it. Does nothing for a link that is down',
  '                      for any other reason.',
  '- fix_p2p_mtu      : fault is that the two ends of one link disagree on MTU.',
  '- restore_bgp_neighbor : fault is that a BGP session was administratively',
  '                      shut. Un-shuts it. Does nothing for a session that is',
  '                      down for any other reason.',
  '- sync_from_netbox : fault is CONFIG DRIFT — the running config no longer',
  '                      matches NetBox. Re-applies NetBox intent.',
  '- sync_from_pillar : same, where the source of truth is pillar/YAML.',
  '- golden_config    : fault is PROTOCOL DRIFT — IS-IS, BFD or BGP session',
  '                      settings no longer match the fabric plan.',
  '- bgp_policy       : fault is POLICY DRIFT or a ROUTE LEAK — the routing',
  '                      policy on the box no longer matches NetBox, or the box',
  '                      is advertising prefixes to a peer that NetBox does not',
  '                      permit: internal space, more-specifics escaping an',
  '                      aggregate, or routes learned from one provider being',
  '                      sent to another. Re-applying the NetBox policy is what',
  '                      stops the announcement. A capacity or threshold problem',
  '                      is neither drift nor a leak.',
  '- none             : NO template above actually addresses this fault',
  '',
  'If nothing in the list genuinely fixes this fault, you MUST answer',
  '"none". Picking a template that does not address the fault is worse',
  'than escalating to a human: these templates are idempotent, so a wrong',
  'choice succeeds, changes nothing, and leaves the real fault unhandled',
  'while looking like it was handled.',
  '',
  'In particular, answer "none" when the fault is about CAPACITY or a',
  'THRESHOLD — a prefix limit being approached, a table filling, a counter',
  'rising. No configuration push fixes those, and widening a limit because',
  'the limit warned you is disabling the safety device because it went off.',
  'The same applies to anything PHYSICAL: a link that is down while the',
  'configuration is already correct.',
  '',
  'Fault type: ' + j.fault,
  'Device: ' + j.device,
  'Interface: ' + j.interface,
  'Peer: ' + (j.peer || ''),
  'Detail: ' + j.detail,
].join('\n');

return [{ json: Object.assign({}, j, {
  // The model name comes from the environment, so switching models is a
// change to .env rather than to this workflow.
  ollamaBody: JSON.stringify({ model: $env.OLLAMA_MODEL || 'llama3.1',
                               stream: false, prompt: prompt })
})}];
